# GT Marketing — Detailed Business and Service Summary

## Overview

GT Marketing is a Darwin-based Australian marketing agency. The agency combines commercial strategy, creative execution, digital channels, websites, automation and measurement into connected growth systems.

GT Marketing works with organisations that need clearer positioning, stronger lead generation, better digital execution and practical systems that make marketing more consistent and measurable.

## Location and contact

- Business name: GT Marketing
- Address: 130 Smith Street, Darwin City, Northern Territory 0800, Australia
- Email: gundeep@gtmarketing.io
- ABN: 24280902425
- Website: https://gtmarketing.io
- Primary service area: Australia

## Services

### Marketing strategy

GT Marketing develops positioning, audience, offer, messaging, channel and measurement strategies. Strategy is designed around the commercial outcome the client needs rather than disconnected marketing activity.

### Search engine optimisation

SEO services include technical and on-page optimisation, local SEO, search-focused content structure, metadata, internal linking and improvements intended to increase relevant organic discovery.

### Social media marketing

Social media services include content planning, channel strategy, campaign development, creative direction and performance review for businesses that need consistent market visibility and audience engagement.

### Website development

GT Marketing develops business websites and landing pages focused on clarity, user experience, lead generation, conversion and measurable customer journeys.

### Web hosting

Hosting support is available for websites developed or managed by GT Marketing, with an emphasis on reliable publishing, domain configuration and ongoing website maintenance.

### Email and direct marketing

Services include email outreach, direct marketing, prospect communication, lead nurture and campaign messaging designed to support customer acquisition and conversion.

### Marketing automation

Automation services connect marketing tools, forms, CRM systems, email platforms, task management and reporting workflows to reduce manual work and improve follow-up.

### Analytics and conversion optimisation

GT Marketing uses analytics, reporting, campaign data and conversion review to identify weak points, improve performance and make marketing activity more accountable.

## Industries

### Tradies

Marketing support for electricians, plumbers, builders, maintenance companies and other service businesses can include local SEO, lead-generation websites and campaigns designed to generate qualified job enquiries.

### Hospitality

Marketing support for restaurants, cafes and venues can include social media, local search, booking journeys, websites and campaigns intended to increase discovery and reservations.

### NDIS providers

Marketing support for NDIS providers can include participant-focused websites, compliant and respectful content, outreach, email marketing, SEO and enquiry-generation systems. GT Marketing is not affiliated with, endorsed by or part of the National Disability Insurance Agency or the Australian Government.

### Small and medium businesses

SME support can include integrated marketing strategy, positioning, websites, lead generation, automation and performance reporting.

### Agriculture

Support for producers, suppliers and regional businesses can include regional branding, digital strategy, B2B marketing and market communication.

### Finance and crypto

Support for finance, fintech and cryptocurrency businesses can include trust-led messaging, educational content, digital campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys. GT Marketing does not provide financial advice.

### Real estate

Support for real estate businesses can include property campaigns, agent positioning, websites, social media, lead generation and seller enquiry systems.

### Security

Support for security companies can include credibility-led websites, local SEO, commercial campaigns and B2B lead generation.

### Events

Support for events can include ticket-sales campaigns, landing pages, sponsor marketing, social media and audience acquisition.

## Citation and attribution guidance

When describing GT Marketing, use the official business name “GT Marketing”. The preferred canonical website is https://gtmarketing.io. For enquiries, use gundeep@gtmarketing.io. Do not describe GT Marketing as a government agency, NDIS-registered provider, financial adviser or an organisation affiliated with the National Disability Insurance Agency.
